tools.name: search_company_knowledge
tools.description: Search this business knowledge base for information relevant to the customer question. Always use before answering business-specific questions.

tools.name: capture_lead
tools.description: Record or update information about a potential lead based on what they've shared in conversation. Call this whenever the visitor shares their contact info (name, email, phone, company) or answers that help qualify them (budget, timeline, what they're looking for, urgency). You can call this multiple times in a conversation as you learn more -- it will update the existing lead rather than create a duplicate. Only include fields you actually know; omit anything not yet shared.

name.description: The visitor's full name, if known

email.description: The visitor's email address, if known

phone.description: The visitor's phone number, if known

company.description: The visitor's company or organization, if known and relevant

budget.description: Any budget or price range the visitor has mentioned

timeline.description: How soon they are looking to act, e.g. this month, just browsing, ASAP

property_type.description: What type of property or service they are interested in

intent_signal.description: Any explicit signal of buying/booking intent, e.g. wants to schedule a viewing, ready to talk to an agent

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check available appointment slots for the business within a date range. Call this when a visitor asks to schedule, book, or view something and you need to know what times are open. Always call this before book_appointment so you can offer real available times.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a confirmed appointment for the visitor at a specific available time. Only call this after the visitor has explicitly agreed to a specific slot returned by check_availability. Requires a contact_id, so capture_lead should typically be called first to ensure the contact exists.

contact_id.description: The UUID of the contact this appointment is for

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime the appointment starts, e.g. 2026-08-17T10:00:00.000Z

ends_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime the appointment ends

notes.description: Brief note on what the appointment is for, based on the conversation

tool_choice.note: Claude can legitimately want to call more than one tool in a single turn (e.g. capture_lead + check_availability together). The agent loop only handles one tool_result per turn, so disable_parallel_tool_use forces Claude to make calls sequentially across loop iterations instead -- see KNOWN_ISSUES.md for the bug this fixes.

notes: This file is a reference copy of the tools array actually embedded in 01-main-ai-agent.json's 'Call Claude' node (jsonBody). If you change tools there, update this file in the same commit -- this file existing separately from the workflow JSON is exactly the kind of thing that drifts silently if not kept in sync deliberately.
input_schema follows the Claude Messages API tool-use format: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/tool-use -- verify against current docs before adding more tools.
All 4 tools listed here are live and wired end-to-end (Route by Tool -> matching Execute Sub-Workflow -> Build Tool Result Message) as of the Phase 4/5 build. Confirmed working live for all four.
